puttamatā.p: [ putta + mata. Ā ] (thī) CL=10 The one who has a dead son-ājīvaka ascetic (mother), A mother with a dead child. (With no virtuous life, the ājīvaka ascetics are called the dead, the mother of those dead is the one having a dead child, and the sons of that mother are the ājīvaka ascetics.)
